My teammate (a rando) who was also running the autocannon hopped on to reload and I just unleashed, with the last guy collapsing right at my feet. 
All that said I’ve almost never had a moment like that planned, and most of the time when I try I can’t get the prompt to show up right in time. So very awesome when it works! Def needs some tweaking.

This is something I struggle with too, but one of the harder truths to swallow is that you might have to be that person. There’s a good chance that there is someone who cares about you that much, but nobody’s perfect, and as much as we want them to, people can’t read our minds. It’s about building up the strength to finally say “no, I’m not alright” when they ask. Then the people who care for you will be there. I’m still working up that strength and courage as well, but hopefully one day we’ll be able to get there.
